phrases.en: My grandfather Malaboy with my grandmother Rachel Uvadeva had seven children: Aboi Mala, Bulur, Imashalom, Miriam, my father Yehuda-Ari (Meli), Israel, and Bakhmal. My uncle Abo was a kind, rich, noble person, an aristocrat, a merchant of the First Guild, and had several factories. He was helping the Jews, but was a gambler. His wife Betty was a daughter of Hayim Wadiaef. Both of my aunts married Wadiaef sons: Miriam married Sion son of Haim Wadiaef and Bakhmal married Rafael son of Izhak-Baruch Wadiaef.
phrases.bux: Bovom, Malaboy, bivim Rohel Uvadeva qati hafta bacha doshtin: Aboyi Mala, Bulür, Imosholüm, Miryom, Yahudo-Ari (Meli) - dadim, Isroel, Baxmal. Abo 'amakam odami nek, boy-badavlat, odamshavanda, asilzoda, savdogari gildiyi yakum budin, chandta fabriku zavod doshtin. Ba juuto yordam medodin, lekin qartaboz bu. Zanash, Bitiyo, duxtari Hayim Vadyaev bu. Duta 'amom ba duta farzandoyi Vadyaefo rasidan. Miryom ba Sion ben Hayim Vadyaev va Baxmal ba Rafoel ben Isok-Borux Vadyaev.
